reviews.text: We take our 8 year old cat to Wrigleyville Vet for all his non-emergency vet needs. They were able to get him in same day within a few hours for a sick visit. The tech and the vet were fantastic with him. They were clear about what they thought was going on, they gave options for treatment, had a plan for following up within 24 hours to reassess the condition. Overall, I'm very happy with our visit there as we always are.
Quick and easy appointment for my kitty as always!
Wonderful service and staff. We didn’t have to wait very long to be seen and everyone was kind, the vet was thorough, and we appreciated the great care Marty got!
We have been working with the team here for years and continue to feel so well supported with our pup’s care!

Very disappointed with my experience with Dr. Rolando Silva. I brought my dog in because he has a history of IVDD and specifically asked him to examine his back. (I had to ask because he wasn’t even gonna examine my dog until I asked him to.) The examination felt very rushed, and when I asked questions, I felt like I was being talked down to instead of having my concerns taken seriously.

Dr. Silva said there was something still going on with my dog’s back, but didn’t explain what he thought was happening, what I should watch for, or what I should do next. I left the appointment with no real answers or guidance. For what I paid, I expected a much more thorough examination and better communication. I left feeling dismissed and disappointed.
Got a definite feeling of stress - beyond my own. Hard to put my finger on. Certainly there were no red flags
Amazing practice with great staff. I will continue to bring my pup here!
Great Vet!
We love Wrigleyville Veternary Center! The entire staff is excellent. Our dog always gets the best care.
My pal Woody has ear infection every so often I am great full for staff and Dr. Schlasberg for taking time to explain the problems and solutions to Woodys ssues. Great staff and timely response.
The staff and veterinarian we saw were all lovely, thoughtful, and caring. I especially appreciated that they had both kitty and dog treats on the counter!

My pup loves coming to daycare here! The daycare prices are reasonable, and my dog gets so excited when I tell him we’re going to daycare. They also run 10% off daycare package promos, which are always nice. They’ll also walk dogs after morning playtime upon request with no extra charge, which is nice. During and after the first visit, I got pictures of my dog and a summary of how his day was. I didn’t get similar updates after that, but I didn’t mind much. I’m sure I would’ve gotten them again if I asked.

My dog also gets groomed here, which has been a great way to get him used to the groomer. Grooming is a little pricey, but Paul is so kind with the dogs and always does an amazing job! He’s very thoughtful when explaining how the dog does and will explain how their breed and coat makes grooming unique. Paul makes the experience feel worth the price! Daycare is also significantly cheaper compared to Sit Social, so I justify the expensive grooming with the cheaper daycare.

It’s also worth noting they offer $10 off for 5 star reviews, so that undoubtedly inflates their rating.

I absolutely love taking my dogs here. I have a young, dog-reactive, man hating, trazadoned rescue and there have been so many times we have left a vet feeling so much shame. This is the first place where I really feel like he was accepted without judgement of his behavior. Their entire team is incredible, from the front desk, to the techs, to the vets themselves, everyone is always so welcoming and understanding. I’d say pricing is pretty standard to most vets in the area, but another thing I love is their wellness plan. I also have a senior dog and insuring a 10 year old dog is NOT cheap, so their wellness plan is a great option for us. It gives me some peace of mind in knowing I can bring her in any time that I’m even slightly concerned, and the cost of her visit is covered. They’re super knowledgeable and I never feel rushed when asking my 1000 questions to the vet. Dr. DeSollar and Dr. Slossberg are both great! Definitely recommend Wrigleyville Vet!

***Wellness check cost over $700***

Brought my healthy 10-year-old lab mix in for a routine wellness exam ($96) and left paying over $700 — including almost $500 in urine/bloodwork. At no point during our discussion of the tests was the high cost mentioned.

My dog is healthy with minor concerns. I've had my dog's urine/blood tested before, and have not paid nearly this rate. Ask for a written itemized estimate before you consent to any testing.

We always love visiting Dr. Lieberman at Wrigleyville for our 2 cats annual check ups. She also took care of our older cat the last few years of her life. I’ll always remember that when she did pass, she sent us an incredibly thoughtful hand written note. Will continue to take our pets here! Great clinic!
I have a difficult cat.  She only likes me.  But the people at Wrigleyville were really patient with her and me.  Have been going here for a couple of years and do recommend them.

I recently had my dog groomed by Paul at the Wrigleyville Veterinary Center. Paul was incredibly friendly and spent a lot of time speaking with me about the groom and my dog. My dog is a senior Australian Shepard with ton of fur and a dual-coat. He's a tough job for any groomer! When Arlo came out, he looked like a brand-new dog. We truly cannot believe it - his coat looks incredibly healthy and he's so much more comfortable. I was blown away and set up recurring grooms on the spot. If you're looking for a groomer, especially one for a complex coat or a senior, I can't recommend Paul enough!
Very profesional and knowledgeable of there job kamilo is all cleaned up thank you Wrigleyville veterinarian center to the groomer. Excellent job.

Excellent staff! Have been using Wrigleyville Vet since we moved to the area 2+ years ago. Scheduling appointments is easy & you are able to be seen quickly. Medical team is knowledgeable & takes time to answer your questions/concerns. Facility is very clean!

7/28/2026

Another incredible visit to receive your vaccines and a nail trim for my cat the front desk always incredible warm, friendly and makes you feel like you’re visiting their home. Doctors and techs are on point always pleasant. Will explain any questions if you don’t live in the city. it’s definitely worthwhile to drive into the city to bring your pet to them for care

5/26/2026
Going to Wrigleyville Vet is like going to a friend's home. Warm, caring, professional assistance. Samantha, you always make me feel special, thank you.

3/25/2026
Another great experience today. From the time on the phone to make the appointment and the welcome at the lobby desk it was a professional caring visit. Jackie made the experience at the lobby desk for me.

A great visit today 8/11/2025 with Dr. Hardiman & Sergio for the wonderful service and attention to detail.

Professional, caring individuals at this center. Front desk very efficient and always pleasant. Entire staff very professional and will explain costs and procedures. You will not be disappointed.

11/21/2025
Samantha and Jackie at front desk always make me feel that WVC cares about me as a client and always gives my pet caring attention. This is definitely the place to take your pet for incredible care.
Always a good experience.

I’ve been taking Little Brother here since I adopted him from Paws in 2023. They have always taken such good care of him through our regular yearly visits and when we have had to go when he is sick or injured. I just recently took him for an illness related visit and they were wonderful as always! Here is a picture of him when he’s well and pictures of visits through the years! Thanks for always taking such good care of LB!
Staff was able to quickly respond to my plethora of questions in a calm manner.
Gave me a lot of peace of mind and answered all my questions about my pet! Highly recommend

Ridley, the vet was great. We’re from out of town and we have our dogs with us.  Our male  golden developed a bad rash on his stomach which was keeping him from sleeping and making him very uncomfortable. They were able to fit us in right away and gave us medicine that seems to have solve the problem. I was very happy with the service we got
Our babies were very well taken care of. Very professional and friendly...
Fantastic! They really care here. :)

Dr. Ariana Gross was wonderful with my senior cat, who has a chronic illness. She took the time to discuss treatment options, was reassuring throughout the visit, and helped me understand which management options made the most sense for him. The entire staff was great, the facility was clean, and scheduling an appointment was easy and convenient. I left feeling much more confident about his care and would highly recommend Dr. Gross and the clinic.
Everyone here is so friendly & you can tell they really care about their furry patients
I love Wrigleyville Vet! Everyone is so kind and attentive.

I have/had been using this vet for a couple years. I’ve since moved and found another vet, they are amazing which has made my experience with Wrigleyville Vet continue to sit on my mind.  Multiple times would additional charges or services be added without transparency. I once went in for annuals and the vet tech cleaned his ears without expressing any additional cost. They don’t pose it as a question, it’s, “we went ahead and cleaned his ears for you….” Like they did you a favor, not telling you its additional or give you the option to decide and then will add $300 to your bill.  I can get a $20 bottle of ear cleaner on chewy and do the same quality job. It makes me question the quality and candor of my veterinary care when vets try to add all these additional services on in the back end.
When I addressed it I was accused of not being able to afford to have pets and being irresponsible.
Stop profiting off of the pain of animals and taking advantage of the fear of pet parents!

That isn't the first time I have received micro-aggressive comments front the workers. It isn’t even the worst experience, in my opinion. My worst experience was with the doctor when I was going in for a visit.
I have a smooth brained 7 year old chocolate lab that is the sweetest most lovable boy in the world! He is an anxious boy sometimes but has never had any vet related anxiety. He has hip dysplasia in both hips and so is pretty comfortable in vets now due to how much he was there as a pup. PLUS…He loves people, and people love him and he knows it. And will milk it for all it is worth.
The last time I went in for an office visit, my dog greeted the vet with the most friendly of hellos, rushing up tail wagging to say hello, greeting the vet with kisses. The doctor turned to me and very pointedly said “I’m always skeptical of an owner when their dog is so happy to see me…”!
I can’t remember what my response was honestly, I was shocked. Because WHAT, SIR, DO YOU MEAN BY THAT?!
That because literally the poster child of sweet derpy dog breeds greeted you with love, their owner must be abusive?? That’s crazy!

Or perhaps was it the color of my skin that made you jump from logical reason to “this person must be an animal abuser” or “this person is irresponsible and can’t afford to take care of their pet”…

Batman always feels comfortable at this vet! Water, treats, and, most importantly, quality, individualized care at an affordable cost, especially in relation to its competitors in the neighborhood! In fact, his doctors have always offered to modify & fill his prescriptions upon requests within the same year of his appointment, and they’ve also offered home remedies to accommodate our needs in the meantime.
We're thrilled to hear about your positive experience at Wrigleyville Veterinary Center. Thank you for sharing your feedback!

Dr. Grosse made our visit as pleasant as possible. We were there to assess our dog for a possible ear infection and she took the time to explain why collecting a sample for cytology analysis was important, both for the immediate treatment and potentially as a way to prevent future issues. She kept us apprised of how our dog was doing while the vet techs cleaned her ears and then explained what the cytology showed. Our pup left happy and in much better shape with a good care plan in place. Dr. Grosse is new to Wrigleyville Vet and we are glad she has joined the team. She is amazing!
Your feedback is incredibly valuable. Thank you for sharing your experience at Wrigleyville Veterinary Center.
Your positive experience at Wrigleyville Veterinary Center means a lot to us. Thank you for choosing us for your pet's care.

While I have excellent experiences with the vets at Wrigleyville, they have borderline (and sometimes outright) unethical business practices as related to to their Wellness Plans which are absolutely NOT worth anything and I would strongly advise anyone against purchasing it. Not only would pet insurance be a better and more financially sound investment, there are several things in regard that I feel others should be warned about.

First, the front desk and vet won’t tell you that the wellness plans are only for 12 months. Over two years I paid over $2 into the plan only to be told cancelling would incur a fee because the renewal for one of my dogs was in recent months. Not only does this mean almost a thousand dollars went to nothing, unable to be used, but the front desk and the vet directly contradict their wellness team. The front desk is clear that the wellness is ran separately from their main business, so the disconnect must happen there. But when one tells you something and you sign up for it…

And probably the most egregious is the wellness team trying to retroactively change invoice prices after we agreed on services, paid, and only when trying to cancel the wellness plan did they say prices were incorrect (prices that add up to having to owe.) Again, we got went to get vaccines, they presented us with the charges, we agreed and paid, got the receipt and invoice, and in an email months later tried to change price total for stuff we never agreed to pay in the first place (attaching screenshots.) I’ve never seen a business go back and start changing prices at a whim just to suit a need. We have also experienced issues where their Wellness team texted THE WRONG OWNER of the dogs to communicate dog issues.

So two stars for the vets. Beyond that, NEVER purchase their Wellness plan. Not only is it not worth it, it’s borderline a scam and their wellness team business practices borderline unethical.

The entire staff takes exceptional care of our dog both as our vet and daycare. Our pup LOVES being there! The vets are so good at taking time and explaining everything and never being in a rush. The daycare staff are our dog’s favorite people. And their support and front desk staff are so nice, friendly and knowledgeable. We wouldn’t go anywhere else, and I don’t think our dog would allow it!

Wrigleyville Animal Hospital cares for all three of my dogs.  They attend doggy daycare here as well. One of my Scottie’s had a health emergency last week.  Dr. Lieberman saved her life and continues to go above and beyond to make sure she is recovering. I am so grateful!  Honestly, the love, care and attention that EVERYONE who works here gives to animals and people is second to none.  With three dogs- two with health issues, I feel like I have experienced just about everything they offer.  The front desk staff, the veterinary technicians, the daycare team, and the veterinarians are all AMAZING!! Love from the trio-Maggie Mae, Bonnie Belle and Poppy Purl!!💕🐾💕
Wrigleyville is always kind, caring and compassionate and treats my four-legged babies the way I would.

First off, the only reason I took my cat here is because they advertised a wellness program that sounded really affordable for pet owners on a budget or low-income folks. The exam fee alone was $96, but the wellness plan was a $55 enrollment fee plus $49/month, which seemed much more manageable long-term.

What upset me is that nowhere on their website or during scheduling was there any mention that certain medical conditions could disqualify pets from joining the program.

During the exam, the vet listened to my cat’s heart and told me he has a heart murmur, which I had no prior knowledge of. I was then informed he did not qualify for the wellness program at all. After that, the only option presented was a $99 heart test to determine whether the murmur indicated an actual abnormality, followed by the possibility of seeing their traveling cardiologist for around $1,200.

I completely understand that heart conditions can complicate treatment plans, and I’m not upset that my cat may need specialized care. What I AM upset about is that there was no transparency beforehand that a condition like this could immediately disqualify a pet from the program. I spent roughly $140 total between the exam and pet transportation just to be told he couldn’t enroll. I paid MORE than the program cost for no vaccines, no bloodwork, no treatment plan, and no financial assistance options beyond being handed low-cost resources elsewhere.

The lobby was nice and the reception staff were kind. This review is not about them personally. But as a low-income pet owner with a limited budget, this experience was extremely financially and emotionally devastating.

If your cat may have a heart condition or any unknown medical issue, I would strongly recommend asking detailed qualification questions before booking an appointment here so you are not blindsided by the costs.
We love this vet! They did so great with our cat Luna!

This place is amazing! The vet is incredible. It’s the first time in years that I felt I could advocate for my dog and was being heard. Both the veterinary and the technician were incredibly knowledgeable and thoughtful in their approach. Even when they did not agree with my misinformed assumptions, they walked me through options, explaining both pros and cons and let me come to my own conclusion with their recommendation.
They take such excellent care of the animals here! Highly recommended to anyone in the lakeview area!

The whole staff at wrigleyville Vet is amazing! Very courteous and always seems happy to see us! Having great care is something of utmost importantance to me, especially as I have 4 boys! My Boys see Dr Lieberman and she is the absolute best, and just the greatest with all of them, especially with Beau. I could not be happier than I am with her and trust her Wholeheartedly! She always makes sure Beau’s asthma is watched and managed carefully with medication and a plan that works/ is tailored to his specific needs 😻Thanks to everyone there! 😽😸

Dr. Silva was amazing. It was our first visit here, and he answered all of my questions about my cat with patience and kindness. He offered different treatment plans, and his out of the box thinking on potential diagnoses made me feel like he was truly providing specialized care. I highly recommend Dr. Silva.
Love the friendly staff, the welcoming environment & the Wellness Plan!

Dr. Lieberman is amazing and was so sweet with my dog! She  is very thorough with her exam and transparent with how tests may or may not yield results to aid in diagnosis. I really appreciated her transparency in explaining the purpose of proposed tests. She was also very purposeful with performing tests and evaluating results one at a time to avoid unnecessary associated costs. Jackie, the client care coordinator at the front desk is also great and remembered my dog from earlier that week and seemed to truly care how she was doing. I highly recommend Wrigleyville Vet!

I had a very frustrating and concerning experience at Wrigleyville Veterinary Center and feel compelled to share it so other pet owners can make informed decisions.

I brought my dog in immediately after witnessing him swallow a small ball during a walk. Naturally, I was worried about a potential obstruction and wanted prompt, appropriate care. The veterinarian induced vomiting, but when the ball did not come up, instead of moving forward with the next logical step, they questioned whether my dog had even swallowed it at all. I repeatedly assured them that I saw it happen.

Eventually, the vet suggested an X-ray but oddly tried to downplay its usefulness, claiming the ball might not even show up. This was confusing and concerning, as the object clearly had components that would be visible—which the X-ray ultimately confirmed. The image showed, without a doubt, that my dog had swallowed the ball.

At that point, I expected a clear plan of action. Instead, I was told they do not perform endoscopic procedures—something that was not disclosed earlier—and was advised to go to an emergency facility. Despite the situation involving a foreign object that could potentially cause a blockage, the vet minimized the urgency and suggested it could wait overnight. That did not sit right with me.

What made the situation more uncomfortable was the repeated push toward specific emergency clinics. After stepping away to think, I noticed pamphlets in the office for the same places being recommended, which made the suggestions feel less about my pet’s immediate needs and more like a referral pattern.

Ultimately, I chose to seek care elsewhere—somewhere that was willing to evaluate and treat my dog promptly. Thankfully, the front desk staff member was kind and helpful in transferring my dog’s records, and I truly appreciate her professionalism during an otherwise upsetting experience.

As a pet owner, you trust your veterinarian to take your concerns seriously, communicate transparently, and act in your pet’s best interest. Unfortunately, that was not my experience here. I left feeling dismissed, misled, and unsupported during a stressful situation.

I would strongly encourage others to consider their options carefully before bringing their pets here, especially in urgent situations where timely and decisive care is critical.

We have had an excellent experience with this clinic! The front desk staff are all friendly and very helpful. Dr. DeSollar and Dr. Lieberman have both been very helpful and communicative with helping our dog with her vet needs. They even rearranged Friday evening hours to help squeeze her in for an appointment before the weekend. Would recommend for anyone looking for a vet!
Super helpful in scheduling an appointment on short notice, and as always the people are so nice and caring for Otis and the humans!
Wrigleyville veterinary always has a ton of appointments and I’ve gotten great service whenever I have to take my dog in!
Always take Oliver here, they are professional and kind.
Friendly staff. Vet very professional and efficient.   Facility clean and bright.
My Pug just got groomed here and he’s a bit of a handful. The front desk staff was friendly and Paul did an amazing job on the groom.
Dr Ken and the entire staff are top notch. 100% recommend.

If you go here, god luck! From conflicting diagnoses between in house doctors, staff that “forgets” to call or text you when you’re prescription is ready: this place is a mess. I’ve had wrong prescriptions, wrong quantities filled. All they offer is a “sorry”. Also, if you need your medication before 48 hours, you can get it for a fee- ridiculous. The price to quality of care is not there. I will absolutely be taking my business somewhere else that takes my pets health more seriously.

The staff at Wrigleyville Veterinary Center is absolutely outstanding. I was recently dog-sitting my son's new puppy when she suddenly fell ill. I scooped her up, grabbed my phone, asked Siri to direct me to the nearest vet, and I was off. I'm sure I had a pretty intense demeanor when I walked in, but the front desk administrator was perfectly calm, engaging and obviously ready to help without delay. A vet tech saw me standing there--clearly interested in getting the puppy into the hands of a vet ASAP--and he quickly took her into the back. Within 15 minutes Dr. Hardiman, who was fantastic, had checked her vitals and came into the room to consult.

Can't say enough about this practice...and I can be a tough sell. Oustanding job all the way around! Highly recommended.
Everyone is so nice and caring for my kitties!
Always friendly and helpful staff.  Harper actually like visiting Wrigleyville Vets.

Everything about this clinic is wonderful. The staff are kind, caring & knowledgeable. The doctors have incredible understanding of treating animals, while working with their human owners with empathy. My dog is excited to visit whether it’s for daycare or a doctor visit, which is all I can ask for! I only wish their boarding services came back!
My corgi's nails were way too long and I came to WVC.  Other groomers I went to barely cut any of the nail. These guys did a great job.  I would definitely give these guys a look,

This is my daycare and vet. This business is pure gold. The employees-every single one is kind and professional and quick to respond to your every need! If I could give 27000 stars I would. My mom loves it too. Sometimes I need a break from her and I just give my friends at Wriggleville a call and I am wisked away to heaven on earth with all my puppy pals! Love, Finn

We had an incredible daycare experience for our dog. The team is warm, attentive, and truly treats every pup like family. They create a safe, fun, and engaging environment where dogs can play, relax, and feel completely at ease. I always appreciate the care, communication, and genuine love they show. It is clear they are passionate about what they do. Our dog comes home happy, tired, and well‑loved every time. Highly recommend their daycare services!
great first visit!! transparent about pricing/options too
I really enjoyed my visit with Dr. Slossberg for our pup. He was very kind and patient with my questions and extremely knowledgeable.
Always friendly and professional service.  Dr. Schlossberg is amazing and takes the time to answer any and all questions.
Dr Da Silva was wonderful with both of my cats with 2 very different issues.Staff very friendly and very reasonable expense
Great service!!

As always, the friendly staff made the experience as easy as possible. The vets here are so detailed in reporting all medical information clearly, and always provide a few options if recommending treatments. This makes it helpful for people that may not be able to afford one option feel comfortable in having other selections available!
Very nice, professional, and clean! Great vet!

I am incredibly grateful to the team at Wrigleyville Veterinary on Halsted. After my dog was attacked, we rushed him in at the very end of the day, and they took him back immediately. A veterinarian examined him right away, and the entire staff was calm, compassionate, and genuinely caring during an extremely stressful situation.
They even went above and beyond by providing me with gauze and towels to help stop my own bleeding from the attack. The level of care, urgency, and kindness shown to both my dog and me was truly exceptional. I cannot thank them enough and would highly recommend them.

We have been going to this vet for several years. Recently, the service and support has gone down hill. They where acquired by another vetinary company (M&A) are no longer locally owned. They do not have weekend hours and will not allow you to get perscriptions done over the phone for other pharmacies. They make you come to their location to get the perscription. Furthermore, they can't even fill the perscription correctly. They just filled one for our dog and filled it incorrectly. Thank goodness we paid attention and didnt give our dog the wrong doaage. Its just sad what has happened to this vet.
Thank you so so much!

My compliments to the new technician, JoAnn.  She was such a pleasure to work with when I came in for a tech appointment.  Asked questions, listened intently, provided recommendations, and then gave me a full debrief after the service was completed - what a pleasant experience!  The front desk staff was very helpful and friendly, as always.

It's obvious that the staff truly loves animals here! They have been absolutely wonderful, helping my dog manage his hot spots, taking care of his annual vaccines, and providing excellent care overall. 5 stars—highly recommend this caring team!

Great staff, great vet Dr Ken, great dog treats.

Gladys the Great Dane
I appreciated the time the doctor spent with my dog and they met my expectations on the annual shot updates. 😁 …

The staff here is great! I’ve been coming here for over four years with my little one. The most recent policy change communicates that this veterinary practice is over-prioritizing their bottom line $$$ income over consideration for care that is within arms reach for our animals.

Unfortunately, if you need a prescription, they changed their policy to where they don’t do direct verification through third party pharmacies, like Chewy or even Walgreens + CVS (why?). This means that when I need to refill my prescription at Walgreens after my max refill quantity has been met, they do not do easy verification- I need to go to WrigleyvilleVet in person for a PRINTED PAPER, which I need to then mail to chewy, or drop off to Walgreens…

This policy change puts all clients through frustration and wasted time. They recommended- and are pushing- us to go with the most speedy option, which is to change from Chewy/CVS/Walgreens, to their online pharmacy option. I am not sure why they did this- maybe to rake in more income…

It is borderline disgraceful. I don’t understand this policy change, among a ton of others that I have seen them put in place over the past four years. This one has been the most askew and is quite frankly bizarre. I’ve been to veterinary centers across the city and none are doing it like this.

It is the holiday season. No pet owner has time to come in person and pick up a printed copy and drop it off / mail it to the pharmacy (or even Chewy) and wait for them to refill it after dropping off the paper / mailing it to them.

What a shame… I wish they’d go back from this policy, but I am now left to consider changing my pet’s doctors so that I can actually get their medications more conveniently…

I understand the staff is doing their job. Corporate, or whoever has the agency to put these policies in place needs to reconsult themselves.

Love Wrigleyville and love Dr DeSollar. Our dog loves her too. He had to have surgery recently to have a large lipoma removed. We had his stitches out yesterday and the scar looks fantastic. He is all healed up and doing very well. Staff and vet’s amazing as usual
Great service and kind staff!
We recently lost our family cat after 19 years...the level of service and empathy shown by the entire staff was exceptional. Thank you for making a tough situation less stressful.

I don’t write google reviews but felt it necessary to do so. We recently moved to the area. Unfortunately within the last two months our 19 Year old Yorkie Gigi had went downhill very fast, to the point where she could no longer walk and wasn’t eating, kidney failure, etc. Sadly we had to put her down two weeks ago. The caring, compassion, and walkthrough of the whole process from Dr. Lieberman and her staff during this whole process meant so much to us and how much they really care about our pets. Clearly communicated pricing options of continued care and what was in Gigi’s best interest. The toughest decision we have ever had to make and wouldn’t have been able to get through without them. This was very tough on my wife, and the next time I went in for a visit with our other dog. Dr. Lieberman was checking in to see she was holding up.

As I mentioned we do have another pup that we use for daycare sometimes and for the Vet side. Again, really love having Dr. Lieberman and the vet staff including Roy, who are amazing with Sadie.  Clearly discussed options and timelines of what to expect for dental care that is definitely needed etc and we knew.

If I could rate higher than 5 stars I would. They will always hold a special place in our heart and very appreciative of all of the staff.

I took my dog to Wrigleyville Vet for four years. Each year, they changed policies including drastically changing what their wellness plans would cover, while raising the prices, and most recently, not filling prescriptions on Chewy, favoring their own, more expensive pharmacy partner. My dog is older and struggled a lot going to the vet. They never recommended any way to make the experience less traumatizing for him, like giving him medication to calm down beforehand or limiting what they would do at each visit. I'd hear him screaming from the waiting room, and they would just brush it off. Each time my dog's test results would show anything of concern, they'd recommend just continuing to monitor. So he'd come back for blood work, blood pressure checks, etc. time and time again with no real treatment plan, just continued (expensive) tests.
As a first time dog parent, I fully trusted them. Now that I'm at a new vet, I understand that Wrigleyville does not practice anything related to a fear-free approach, and their treatment plans seem to center around how to squeeze more money out of patients. My new vet identified a grade 4 heart murmur within minutes of meeting my dog; something Wrigleyville had never mentioned.
Wrigleyville vet seems to be focused on making money, so it's probably fine as a day care and a really expensive groomer, but I would not recommend them for any medical services.
Also, there are inflated 5 star reviews as they give discounts when you write a 5 star review.
Dr. Slossberg is the best
They are awesome! It’s always very fast and the staff here is amazing.

I never have to worry about the quality of care my dogs receive here. The staff are friendly, attentive, and transparent with prices for medications and shots. It’s a huge relief to know I can trust this clinic.

This 5 star review is specifically for Dr. Slossberg. He is the reason that I will continue to go to Wrigleyville veterinary clinic despite the high cost. I’ve been family friends with a vet my entire life and Dr. Slossberg still displays more patience, understanding and overall amazing bedside manner than someone I know on a personal level.

I want to avoid talking down on any medical professional, as I know that they are educated and experienced, but I will only be allowing Dr. Slossberg to perform medical procedures on my cats moving forward.

I think it’s also very crucial that your office/doctors emphasize that they will be using Zorbium due to the rare, but potential risks. My cat experienced side effects from this medication that are very uncommon and I was under the impression that she was in pain, but she was having a reaction called paradoxical reaction. I wouldn’t have been aware of this if Dr. Slossberg hadn’t prioritized taking care and assessing my cat asap and having the patience for 30 minute uninterrupted phone call for me to fully understand. Zorbium has a lot of negative reviews and customers deserve to have alternatives or at least be fully educated on the rare but potential side effects that could lead potentially to the death of your animal. Deceptive Billing, Exorbitant Pricing, and Poor Customer Service

My experience with Wrigleyville Veterinary Clinic was defined by deceptive billing and a complete lack of customer care. I was overcharged for multiple services, including being billed for a full office visit when my pet only had a quick tech appointment. When I brought this to their attention, the front desk was dismissive and made everything out to be my fault, and despite a two-month wait for a manager to follow up about a potential refund, no one ever reached out.

Even more concerning, they created an exorbitantly high estimate for a dental procedure on my cat, without fully explaining the issue. The vet themself actually advised me to seek out another clinic for dental care because of the high cost; a huge red flag when the provider discourages you from using their own services.

In stark contrast, my new vet was not only transparent about the issue but clearly explained why the tooth needed to be removed, demonstrating a much higher level of care.

My new vet’s office also noted that they have been taking in a high volume of new customers from this clinic, citing similar issues. This suggests that the recent influx of positive reviews for this clinic is likely an attempt at damage control to offset the truth from customers who have had similar experiences.

Due to their billing practices and poor service, I immediately changed vets and will never return.

Dr. Slossberg was immediately able to identify that something was wrong, get X-rays done, and save my cat's life -- she needed surgery immediately or to be put down.

The emergency vet I went to in the morning was even surprised my regular vet identified that the kitten had this issue since it is so rare and often hard to recognize and commented on how skilled he must be. I really don't know what I would do if it hadn't been for Dr. Slossberg's care and thoroughness to make sure my kitty was checked over. She is alive thanks to him. Twiggy and I are both thankful. I will honestly never go to another vet after this experience.
